Elegant polished fashion illustration with silky painted shading and fine stitched cream piping, clean complete real shoe construction. CHANGE UPPER COLOUR to NEAR-WHITE cool ivory satin (almost white, neutral grey subtle shading), CREAM interior/insole/binding, light tan narrow outsole. No pink colour. Shoe fills 80 percent of image width, leave clear margin on every side. Ground at same horizontal line near 82 percent image height. Preserve reference forefoot camera, slim almond closed toe and proportions. The shoe is a true ballet FLAT, slim almond toe, thin delicate outsole, tiny 1cm heel lift, low complete heel counter and graceful curved topline. Plain closed back, no bow. Match LEFTMOST shoe in reference, but plain neutral white.
